_note: Financial-year (April to March) averages used to calibrate pass-through, operating leverage and demand sensitivity. FY26 = April 2025 to March 2026. brent_usd: Europe Brent spot, US$ per barrel, average of EIA monthly prices (FY26 from EIA STEO quarterly averages 2Q25 to 1Q26); the nightly job should rebuild it from EIA's daily series. usdinr: RBI/FBIL reference rate, FY average of monthly averages (FinLit /api/macro; FY26 completed from x-rates monthly averages because the FinLit series is missing Sep 2025 onwards). cpi, wpi_mfg, wpi_primary, wpi_fuel: FY average of MoSPI's year-on-year rates in % (FinLit /api/macro; FY24 WPI has 9 months). gdp: FY average of quarterly real GDP growth, % (FinLit /api/macro). Rebuild with stress.macro_fy_from_series().
